# Field reference

<!-- Generated by `manage.py export_schemas` from ingest/schemas.py. Do not edit. -->

Every field of every content file. Unknown fields are rejected. Types:

- **Markdown**: rendered text (maths, callouts, links, code). Write it in a block scalar (`|-`).
- **text (one line)**: a short plain label, at most 200 characters.
- **id**: lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, e.g. `fisher-01`.
- **date**: `YYYY-MM-DD`, unquoted.

## course

File: `course.yaml`

What the course is, and its list of topics.

| Field | Type | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | text (one line) | **required** | Full course name. |
| `code` | text (one line) | **required** | Short code shown on the course card, e.g. `MLPR`. |
| `year` | text |  | Academic year in quotes, e.g. "2026-27". |
| `series` | id |  | Only when this folder is another year of a course that already has a folder: the name of that first folder, e.g. `mlpr`. Folders sharing a `series` are one course in different years: the dashboard opens the latest, and the course page offers every year at the top. |
| `semester` | whole number |  | Which semester of the programme the course belongs to, e.g. `5`. The dashboard groups courses by it. |
| `status` | `active` \| `archived` | default `active` | `archived` is a finished course: it is left out of Next up and of the landing page, and without a `semester` it folds away at the bottom of the dashboard. |
| `enabled` | `true` \| `false` | default `true` | `false` keeps the course out of sight until the owner switches it on (here, or in the admin). For a course nobody has reached yet. |
| `has_educator` | `true` \| `false` | default `false` | `true` says someone is writing this course. While it has no content its page then says the content is on its way, instead of asking for an educator. |
| `hue` | whole number | default `250` | Colour of the course, 0-359 on the hue wheel. |
| `order` | whole number | default `0` | Position among courses of the same semester. |
| `description` | text |  | One or two sentences shown under the title. |
| `topics` | list of [TopicSpec](#topicspec) |  | Chapters or units, in teaching order. Everything else refers to these. |

### TopicSpec

| Field | Type | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | id | **required** | Permanent id, e.g. `ch5` or `bayes`. |
| `title` | text (one line) | **required** | Full name of the chapter or unit. |
| `short` | text (one line) |  | Shorter label for chips; defaults to title. |

## document

File: `content/lectures|labs|homework|guides/<name>.md (front matter), content/reference/cheatsheet.md`

The front matter of a Markdown document. The text follows the closing `---`.

| Field | Type | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | text (one line) | **required** | Page title. Do not repeat it as a heading in the text. |
| `number` | whole number |  | Lecture/lab/homework number. Defaults to the digits the file name opens with. |
| `date` | date |  | When it was held. |
| `due` | date |  | Deadline (labs, homework). |
| `topics` | list of id |  | Topic ids this document covers. |
| `summary` | text |  | One or two plain sentences shown in lists. |
| `takeaways` | list of Markdown |  | 3-6 things to remember; shown above the text. |
| `sources` | list of text |  | Files under source/ this was written from, e.g. `lectures/L05.pdf`. |
| `status` | `draft` \| `complete` | default `complete` | `draft` is shown as a label; the page is still visible. |

## deck

File: `content/decks/<deck>.yaml`

A deck of flashcards. One file is one deck.

| Field | Type | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | text (one line) | **required** | Name of the deck. |
| `description` | text |  | One sentence shown on the decks page. |
| `topic` | id |  | Topic of every card that sets none. |
| `lecture` | id |  | File name (without .md) of the lecture this deck drills. |
| `cards` | list of [CardSpec](#cardspec) | **required** | In the order they should be met. |

### CardSpec

One flashcard. Its shape decides its kind: `q` + `a` is a basic card, `q` + `steps` a derivation, `cloze` a fill-in-the-blanks card.

| Field | Type | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | id | **required** | Unique in the whole course, and permanent. |
| `q` | Markdown |  | The prompt. |
| `a` | Markdown |  | The answer exactly as you would write it. |
| `note` | Markdown |  | Commentary: why, context, common traps. |
| `hook` | Markdown |  | A mnemonic for this card. |
| `steps` | list of [StepSpec](#stepspec) |  | Revealed one at a time. |
| `cloze` | Markdown |  | A sentence with {{blanks}} to recall. |
| `hy` | `true` \| `false` | default `false` | High-yield: likely to be examined. |
| `topic` | id |  | `id` of a topic declared in course.yaml. |

### StepSpec

| Field | Type | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `do` | Markdown | **required** | What you write at this step. |
| `why` | Markdown |  | Why that step is allowed. |

## problem-set

File: `content/problems/<set>.yaml`

A practice set: questions with worked solutions, no clock.

| Field | Type | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | text (one line) | **required** | Name of the set. |
| `topic` | id |  | Topic of every question that sets none. |
| `instructions` | Markdown |  | Shown above the questions. |
| `questions` | list of [QuestionSpec](#questionspec) | **required** |  |

### QuestionSpec

One question. `open` questions are worked on paper and need a solution; the other types are answered on the page and marked automatically.

| Field | Type | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | id | **required** | Unique in the whole course, and permanent. |
| `type` | `open` \| `mcq` \| `multi` \| `tf` | default `open` | `mcq` one right choice, `multi` several, `tf` true/false. |
| `title` | text (one line) |  | Short name; defaults to `Question N`. |
| `points` | number |  | Defaults to the sum of its parts. |
| `topic` | id |  | `id` of a topic declared in course.yaml. |
| `q` | Markdown | **required** | The question as set. |
| `parts` | list of [PartSpec](#partspec) |  | Sub-questions (a), (b)… |
| `choices` | list of [ChoiceSpec](#choicespec) |  | For `mcq` and `multi`. |
| `correct` | `true` \| `false` |  | For `tf`: is the statement true? |
| `solution` | Markdown |  | Full worked solution. |
| `steps` | list of [StepSpec](#stepspec) |  | Solution revealed step by step. |
| `answer` | Markdown |  | The final answer on its own. |
| `source` | Markdown |  | Where it came from, or how reconstructed. |

### PartSpec

| Field | Type | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `q` | Markdown | **required** | The sub-question. |
| `solution` | Markdown |  | Worked solution of this part. |
| `points` | number |  |  |
| `label` | text (one line) |  | Defaults to (a), (b), (c)… |

### ChoiceSpec

| Field | Type | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | Markdown | **required** | One answer option. |
| `correct` | `true` \| `false` | default `false` | Set to `true` on the right option(s). |
| `why` | Markdown |  | Shown after answering. |

## paper

File: `content/exams/<exam>/<paper>.yaml`

A past paper or a mock exam. It belongs to the exam whose folder it is in.

| Field | Type | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | text (one line) | **required** | Name of the paper. |
| `kind` | `past` \| `mock` | **required** | `past` opens worked; `mock` opens ready to sit against the clock. |
| `date` | date |  | When the paper was sat. |
| `duration` | whole number |  | Minutes allowed. |
| `marking` | [MarkingSpec](#markingspec) |  |  |
| `instructions` | Markdown |  | The rubric printed on the paper. |
| `questions` | list of [QuestionSpec](#questionspec) | **required** |  |

### MarkingSpec

| Field | Type | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `negative` | number | default `0` | Points lost for a wrong mcq/multi/tf answer, e.g. 0.2. |

## assessment

File: `content/exams/<exam>/assessment.yaml`

One exam to prepare for. Its page shows every card, problem, formula and hook whose topic is in scope, so list only what cannot be derived. Leave `scope` and `includes` empty to cover the whole course.

| Field | Type | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | text (one line) | **required** | Name of the exam. |
| `kind` | `midterm` \| `final` \| `comprehensive` \| `quiz` \| `oral` \| `project` \| `other` | **required** |  |
| `date` | date |  | Exam day; drives the countdown. |
| `scope` | [ScopeSpec](#scopespec) |  |  |
| `includes` | list of id |  | Other exams (folder names) whose scope this one also covers. |
| `format` | Markdown |  | Duration, structure, aids, marking. |
| `weights` | list of [WeightSpec](#weightspec) |  | How much of the paper each topic carries. |
| `plan` | [PlanSpec](#planspec) |  |  |
| `predictions` | list of [PredictionSpec](#predictionspec) |  |  |

### ScopeSpec

| Field | Type | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lectures` | list of whole number |  | Lecture numbers covered. Their topics are included automatically. |
| `topics` | list of id |  | Further topic ids covered. |

### WeightSpec

| Field | Type | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `topic` | id | **required** | A topic id. |
| `weight` | whole number | **required** | 1 = barely examined, 5 = carries the paper. |
| `note` | Markdown |  | The evidence, e.g. which question asks it. |

### PlanSpec

| Field | Type | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `intro` | Markdown |  | One paragraph on how the plan is built. |
| `phases` | list of [PhaseSpec](#phasespec) |  | In the order to do them. |
| `skip` | Markdown |  | What to leave out on purpose, and why. |

### PredictionSpec

| Field | Type | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `q` | Markdown | **required** | A question likely to appear. |
| `why` | Markdown |  | The evidence: past papers, emphasis in class. |
| `likelihood` | `high` \| `medium` \| `low` | default `medium` |  |
| `refs` | list of text |  | Links to other content, e.g. `card:fisher-01`, `lecture:05-features`. |

### PhaseSpec

| Field | Type | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | text (one line) | **required** | `Phase 1`, `Day 2`, `Morning of`… |
| `minutes` | whole number |  | Roughly how long it takes. |
| `title` | text (one line) | **required** | What this block achieves. |
| `why` | Markdown |  | Why it comes at this point. |
| `tasks` | list of [TaskSpec](#taskspec) |  |  |

### TaskSpec

| Field | Type | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tag` | text (one line) |  | Short label: Cards, Practice, Read, Why first… |
| `text` | Markdown | **required** | What to do, concretely. |
| `links` | list of text |  | Links to other content, e.g. `card:fisher-01`, `lecture:05-features`. |

## hooks

File: `content/memory/hooks.yaml`

Mnemonics that are not tied to one flashcard. (A `hook` written on a card appears on the Memory page as well; do not repeat it here.)

| Field | Type | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `hooks` | list of [HookSpec](#hookspec) | **required** |  |

### HookSpec

| Field | Type | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | id | **required** | Unique in the whole course, and permanent. |
| `for` | text (one line) | **required** | What the hook brings back. |
| `kind` | `phrase` \| `acronym` \| `image` \| `story` \| `rhyme` \| `peg` | default `phrase` | The technique, shown as a label. |
| `hook` | Markdown | **required** | The mnemonic itself. |
| `explain` | Markdown |  | How the hook maps onto the real thing. |
| `topic` | id |  | `id` of a topic declared in course.yaml. |
| `refs` | list of text |  | Links to other content, e.g. `card:fisher-01`, `lecture:05-features`. |

## palace

File: `content/memory/palaces/<palace>.yaml`

A memory palace: an ordered list stored along a route the learner knows well.

| Field | Type | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | text (one line) | **required** | Name of the palace. |
| `topic` | id |  | `id` of a topic declared in course.yaml. |
| `encodes` | Markdown |  | What ordered material this stores. |
| `intro` | Markdown |  | The route, described once. |
| `loci` | list of [LocusSpec](#locusspec) | **required** | The stops, in walking order. |

### LocusSpec

| Field | Type | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | id | **required** | Unique within this palace. |
| `place` | text (one line) | **required** | The stop on the route, e.g. `Front door`. |
| `image` | Markdown | **required** | The vivid scene placed there. |
| `means` | Markdown | **required** | What the scene stands for. |
| `refs` | list of text |  | Links to other content, e.g. `card:fisher-01`, `lecture:05-features`. |
